protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed: unauthenticated GET /crontab passes Express-decoded req.query.env_vars to set_crontab; embedded newlines are copied verbatim before scheduled entries into the file installed by crontab(1), permitting injected cron records.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed 0c6cc5512adf5d252b0cd9aa0b7c4c4131661c43 as the smallest first-write: it simultaneously passes req.query.env_vars at the route and prefixes the generated crontab with env_vars plus a newline.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed parent ed99f4b5418144d6bf31a6b9373aad5c5f0d1689: set_crontab took no argument, app.js called it without an argument, and the reviewed parent paths contained no env_vars/envVars identifier or user-controlled crontab prefix.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: Confirmed no decomposition is needed: the BIC is a normal single-parent commit, and GitHub PR #4 reports exactly one member commit, the same 0c6cc5512adf5d252b0cd9aa0b7c4c4131661c43.
protocol_checks.affected_release_membership: Confirmed: every repository release tag present after introduction, from v0.1.8 through v0.4.2, contains the BIC; v0.4.2 still contains the vulnerable route-to-crontab sink. CVE-2026-72590 marks semver 0 through 0.4.2 affected.
protocol_checks.fixed_release_membership: Confirmed no fixed release is identified: the CVE record has no unaffected/patched version and the repository has no tag after v0.4.2.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: Confirmed unpatched: GitHub main remains 870d958669d64dca1d27ff7bf5d616d17ee7553b as of review, and that tree still writes raw envVars plus a newline into the installed crontab; no post-disclosure main commit or direct fix exists.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: Confirmed NOT_AI from the BIC only: its 2016 commit object has human Fantoccini as author and committer, message 'Add textarea for environment variables', and no AI, bot, generated-with, or co-author marker.
